text:
Priya: Heads-up — we need to lock the MVP cutlist by EOD Friday. Can we agree rules so PMs don't reintroduce scope?
Tom: Agree. Proposal: anything behind a non-blocking perf or security fix gets flagged as v1.
Liam: We should also set gating SLOs — perf p95 < 350ms for core API, error rate < 0.5%.
Becky: +1 on SLOs. Also, customer-critical SSO should be a canary feature, not MVP blocker.
Priya: That's my preference. If SSO blocks onboarding for ACME pilot, we enable a temporary identity bypass for pilot orgs.
Tom: Bypass needs clear rollback conditions and an audit log. Ops ok with that?
Mari: Ops: we can do bypass for up to 2 weeks; must be flagged and a support runbook created.
eng-bot: deploy 1765.2 -> staging succeeded :white_check_mark: (logs: https://ci/repo/1765)
Liam: Can we get owner assignments? I'll take performance SLOs, Tom takes security gating, Becky handles pilot exceptions.
Priya: Assignments noted. Also adding a 'parachute' clause: if < 10% of critical flows fail during canary, we pause rollout and revert to model-eviction.
Becky: OK. Need explicit rollback plan in the launch doc. I'll draft it and link in #product tomorrow.
Tom: Quick checklist to finalize: 1) Cutlist approved by eng+pm, 2) SLOs penned, 3) Pilot bypass runbook, 4) Rollback steps. Anyone else?
Priya: That's it from me. If no objections, I'll mark the cutlist frozen and send to stakeholders.
